name: Mam hau
summary: Oysters fermented by hand into a mắm and sold at the daily market to take home.
origin: Côn Đảo. Made by hand, Báo Đồng Nai, 11 July 2025.
howToEat: Buy it as a condiment and a gift pack.
where: Chợ Côn Đảo, the daily market in town.
seoTitle: Mam hau — oyster ferment in Con Dao
seoDescription: Mắm hàu is the hand-made oyster ferment sold at the Côn Đảo daily market.
